description.en: It opens within the screen and its height can now be reduced, so it no longer runs off the edge on 13-inch laptops.
description.zh: 窗口打开时不再超出屏幕，高度也可以调小，13 英寸笔记本上可以完整显示。

title.en: Light and dark stay in step with the Workspace
title.zh: 浅色与深色主题和工作区保持一致

description.en: Switching the theme inside the Workspace takes effect right away, without flickering or switching back.
description.zh: 在工作区内切换主题会立即生效，不再闪烁或被改回。

title.en: Workspace QR codes open on your phone
title.zh: 工作区二维码可在手机上打开

description.en: Scanning the QR code shared from the Workspace now opens it on your phone. Copied workspace links and conversation share links open in any browser as well.
description.zh: 扫描工作区中的分享二维码即可在手机上打开；复制的工作区链接与对话分享链接也可在任意浏览器中打开。
